typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BUS_FILE_NAME as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string ()
}

source(output(
		hc_id as string,
		member_id as string,
		gid as string,
		asm_effective_dt as string,
		plan_no as string,
		pbp as string,
		copay_category as string,
		subsidy_level as string,
		lis_start_date as string,
		lis_end_date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive({Copy of member_id} = member_id,
		{Copy of gid} = gid,
		{Copy of copay_category} = copay_category,
		{Copy of subsidy_level} = subsidy_level,
		{Copy of lis_end_date} = lis_end_date,
		{Copy of asm_effective_dt} = asm_effective_dt,
		{Copy of plan_no} = plan_no,
		{Copy of lis_start_date} = lis_start_date,
		{Copy of hc_id} = hc_id,
		{Copy of pbp} = pbp) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		MEM_ID as string,
		SBSB_ID_FILE as string,
		SUBSIDY_LEVEL as string,
		ASM_EFFECTIVE_DT as string,
		COPAY_CATEGORY as string,
		LIS_START_DATE as string,
		PLAN_NO as string,
		GRGR_ID_FILE as string,
		PBP as string,
		LIS_END_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MEM_ID = {Copy of member_id},
		SBSB_ID_FILE = {Copy of hc_id},
		SUBSIDY_LEVEL = {Copy of subsidy_level},
		ASM_EFFECTIVE_DT = {Copy of asm_effective_dt},
		COPAY_CATEGORY = {Copy of copay_category},
		LIS_START_DATE = {Copy of lis_start_date},
		PLAN_NO = {Copy of plan_no},
		GRGR_ID_FILE = {Copy of gid},
		PBP = {Copy of pbp},
		LIS_END_DATE = {Copy of lis_end_date})) ~> OLEDBDestination
